categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in automotive parts manufacturing, heavy equipment parts (including forklift transmissions and axles), and motorcycle parts. It also engages in electric vehicle components production and renewable energy-related businesses. The automotive parts segment accounts for over 85% of sales, supplying major automakers and parts assemblers domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-precision gear and shaft manufacturing, including transmission components such as differential cases, multi-speed sun gears, dual-clutch transmissions, and electric vehicle reducers. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for powertrain components, electronic shift-by-wire systems, electronic oil pumps, and e-axle systems. Continuous R&D supports development of eco-friendly vehicle parts and new materials like catalysts for plastic recycling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Korean automakers such as Hyundai Motor, Kia Motors, Hyundai Transys, and GM Korea, as well as large parts assemblers. The company also supplies domestic heavy equipment manufacturers like Doosan Industrial Vehicles, Hyundai Construction Equipment, and Clark. Its products serve passenger cars, commercial vehicles, electric and hydrogen vehicles, forklifts, excavators, motorcycles, and aftermarket segments in the US, Europe, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Ulsan, Daegu, Seosan, Iksan, and Seoul. It has overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States (Kentucky), China (previously), and sales offices in Europe. Export markets include the US, Japan, and Europe, with increasing focus on local production and sales in the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive and heavy equipment supply chain, manufacturing core powertrain components and assemblies. It supplies directly to OEMs and large parts assemblers, playing a critical role in component production and assembly for transmissions, axles, and electric vehicle systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transitioning from internal combustion engine parts to future-oriented automotive components such as electric vehicle reducers, electronic transmission control systems, and autonomous driving parts. The company invests heavily in R&D for electric and hydrogen vehicle components, new materials for recycling, and advanced manufacturing technologies. It pursues innovation in electronic shift-by-wire systems, electric oil pumps, and catalyst development for environmental sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of automotive, heavy equipment, and motorcycle parts. The company fulfills orders based on contracts with OEMs and large assemblers, including export sales. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on manufacturing and direct sales, with stable revenue from long-term supply agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic gear and powertrain component manufacturer with a strong foothold supplying major Korean automakers and heavy equipment manufacturers. It holds exclusive supply positions in certain heavy equipment parts and is expanding its presence in electric vehicle components. Competitors likely include other automotive parts suppliers in Korea and globally, but the company emphasizes its technological edge and early adaptation to eco-friendly vehicle parts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved consolidated sales of approximately 728.7 billion KRW and operating profit of 36.1 billion KRW, showing a 4.7% sales increase and improved profitability compared to the previous year. It has a solid asset base exceeding 689 billion KRW and continues to invest in production capacity and R&D. The company has demonstrated resilience and growth despite global economic uncertainties and is expanding its US production footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced technology in powertrain components, and early leadership in electric and autonomous vehicle parts. It offers integrated solutions including electronic transmission control and compact axle assemblies, emphasizing quality, innovation, and responsiveness to OEM needs. Its strategic focus on eco-friendly technologies and new materials positions it as a future-ready supplier with competitive pricing and strong customer relationships.
